[📝Description ]
FAWT is a game where you can start building with advanced tools as soon as you join (Builder). You need to touch the FreeAdmin pad or request from the ServerOwner (SO) to get your admin rank (OwnedRank).

[💡Tips ]
→ How to be the ServerOwner (SO) : be the player who has stayed in the server the longest without leaving
→ How to get your admin rank : touch the FreeAdmin pad
→ How to get FCredits : awarded every 5 min

[⚠️Must know ]
→ Default Command Prefix is ' ; ' 💬
→ Union / CSG Objects arent saved precisely
→ Union / CSG loaded from Toolbox models cannot be saved and will turn into blocky parts once it get saved
→ Default rank in a new server is Builder, not Visitor

[🔨Updates ]
→ Halloween Maps
→ Instance Saving V3
→ Terrain Saving
→ Pose Tool
→ Catalog Avatar
→ CS V6

[👤Note for Roblox Mods ]
Players can load free models from the Toolbox in this game. We filter as much as we can, but if anything bad gets through, that's on the Toolbox moderation, not us.
